tasks.subject: P1 Task 0: region mask + crop
tasks.description:
**Goal:** region_mask (0-360 lon aware) + crop_to_region (along-track band intersecting box) in preprocess.py, plus reusable synthetic-pass builder.

**Files:** Create src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py, tests/_synth.py; Test tests/test_preprocess_crop.py.

**Acceptance:** region_mask 0..360 aware (normalizes region bounds %360); crop_to_region returns (ds_cropped, line_slice) full 69-px width; raises ValueError when no intersection.

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_crop.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py", "tests/_synth.py", "tests/test_preprocess_crop.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_crop.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["region_mask 0..360 aware", "crop_to_region returns intersecting band full width", "raises ValueError when no intersection"]}
```

tasks.subject: P1 Task 1: SSHA + ADT channels
tasks.description:
**Goal:** compute_channels(ds, var_map) -> (2,L,P) [ssha,adt] (ADT=SSHA+MDT), names, mdt_coverage.

**Files:** Modify src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py; Test tests/test_preprocess_channels.py.

**Acceptance:** stack (2,L,P); names [ssha,adt]; adt==ssha+mdt where present, NaN where mdt missing; mdt_coverage==finite fraction.

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_channels.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py", "tests/test_preprocess_channels.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_channels.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["stack (2,L,P) names [ssha,adt]", "adt==ssha+mdt where present NaN where missing", "mdt_coverage finite fraction"]}
```

tasks.subject: P1 Task 2: NaN-pad + tiling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** pad_across_track(stack,pad_to)->(padded,pad_left) + tile_starts/tile_along_track -> (start,(C,128,128)) windows, NaN-pad final partial.

**Files:** Modify src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py; Test tests/test_preprocess_tile.py.

**Acceptance:** pad 69->128 centered pad_left=29; tile_starts stride 64 + final-anchor, n<=128->[0]; tiles (C,128,128) tail NaN-padded.

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_tile.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py", "tests/test_preprocess_tile.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_tile.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pad 69->128 centered pad_left=29", "tile_starts stride 64 final-anchor; n<=128->[0]", "tiles (C,128,128) tail NaN-padded"]}
```

tasks.subject: P1 Task 3: biharmonic inpaint + scikit-image
tasks.description:

**Acceptance:** scikit-image in deps + importable; inpaint_tile filled no-NaNs, mask True where missing; all-NaN channel zero-filled+masked.

tasks.subject: P1 Task 4: preprocess_pass orchestrator + geo round-trip
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tile dataclass + preprocess_pass(ds_or_path,cfg) chaining crop->channels->pad->tile->inpaint -> (tiles,summary,clon,clat); tile_pixel_lonlat round-trip. Confirm on real pass.

**Files:** Modify src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py; Test tests/test_preprocess_pipeline.py.

**Acceptance:** preprocess_pass returns Tile list (data/mask (2,128,128) no NaNs), summary (n_tiles,mdt_coverage,line_slice,channels), cropped lon/lat; tile_pixel_lonlat round-trips (None for padded); real pass -> tiles + prints n_tiles & mdt_coverage; round-tripped pixel in box.

**Verify:** .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_pipeline.py -v ; then real-file run.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/swot_eddy/preprocess.py", "tests/test_preprocess_pipeline.py"], "verifyCommand": ".venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_preprocess_pipeline.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["preprocess_pass returns Tile list+summary+coords, no NaNs in data", "tile_pixel_lonlat round-trips (None for padded)", "real pass yields tiles + prints n_tiles & mdt_coverage; pixel in box"]}
```
